status: adopted: held-out gate met in 20 of 20 target rows (lower95 5.6 to 198 against the full-seed tier); projected-input comparators reported separately
what: tri-Laplacian and the PFC residual by composition of the projected bi-Laplacian program over k = min(D, H) outer directions
hardware: one NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB (exclusive process mode, whole GPU), JAX 0.10.2 with jaxlib 0.10.2 CUDA 12 plugins, CPython 3.12, float64

protocol.repetitions: 3 fresh processes (paired by repetition, rotating method order)
protocol.statistic: ratio = strongest-comparator median / candidate median; lower95 = exp(mean(log r) - 2.920 sd(log r)/sqrt(3))
protocol.qualification: every method on a reduced instance against a 40 to 50 digit mpmath oracle on repetition 0
protocol.compile_time: excluded from the speed ratios and reported separately
protocol.failures: failed, out-of-memory and autotuning-failed members are recorded and suppress their tier from promotion

registered_gate.adoption: lower95 >= 2 against the strongest member of the full-seed tier in cells with D >= 2 H, reported separately against the projected-inner tier
registered_gate.theory: log-log slope of the full-seed / projected ratio against D at fixed k = 16 (D = 48, 64, 96) in [2.5, 3.5]; parity (0.5-2) against the generic engine given the same columns

roles.calibration: seed range disjoint from the held-out seed; used to apply the registered gate only
roles.held_out: frozen protocol, new data seed, no refit

outcome.status: adopted: held-out gate met in 20 of 20 target rows (lower95 5.6 to 198 against the full-seed tier); projected-input comparators reported separately
outcome.summary: Composing the projected bi-Laplacian program over k = min(D, H) outer directions gives the tri-Laplacian and the PFC residual without the full-input sixth-order program. On the frozen held-out seed it beat the strongest completed full-seed comparator (full_comp, folx3 or jet) by a lower95 of 5.6 to 198 in all 20 rows with D >= 2H (five cells, two operators, forward and value-and-gradient); the ratio grows with D at fixed k = 16 with log-log slopes 2.61 to 3.06 (registered band 2.5 to 3.5). Against the existing projected bi-Laplacian program fed the same inputs (inner_proj) it is 2.9 to 8.5x faster.

held_out_numbers.failed_members: folx3: 48 out-of-memory or autotuning failures, nested: 9, jet: 6 (recorded; full_comp was the strongest completed member in all rows from D = 48)

outcome.theory_check: measured / predicted in [1/3, 3] in 18 of 20 target rows (misses: t24_8 pfc vg 0.32 and t24_8 tri forward 0.26); slope band met in 4 of 4 series. Parity with a generic engine fed the same projected columns (folx3_proj) is outside the registered [0.5, 2] in 16 of 20 rows: that engine is 1.7 to 3.3x FASTER than the candidate program, a baseline win that stays visible.
outcome.audit: A1, A3 and A5 pass (396 records, 84 ratios recomputed, max relative difference 0); A4 reports 3 rep-0 records of the baseline nested autodiff at the D < H control cell that failed qualification (parameter directional-derivative check); that baseline is suppressed from the comparison and the three records are listed in the audit, not repaired.
outcome.refuted_or_null: none of the registered adoption or theory criteria is refuted for the full-seed tier; the parity criterion against folx3_proj is missed.
outcome.where_it_does_not_help: D < H (control t12_16): 0.33 to 0.60 of folx3 and jet, i.e. slower. In every D >= 2H cell a generic engine given the same projected columns (folx3_proj) is 1.7 to 3.3x faster than the candidate program, so the gain is over the full-input comparators and over the projected bi-Laplacian program, not over a generic engine fed the projected columns. Cold compile is 4.6 to 34.8 s.
outcome.short: adopted (held-out gate met in 20 of 20 rows)
outcome.notes: The nested-autodiff baseline did not pass the oracle check at the D < H control cell in the value-and-gradient and forward programs (its parameter directional derivative disagreed with the oracle), so it is excluded from the comparison there; the folx3, jet and nested baselines also ran out of memory or failed autotuning in the larger cells, and the strongest completed member is the comparator.
